answer: Spot-checks stop fakes. Each epoch a VRF beacon draws 5% of identities; a drawn agent has 60 seconds to sign a nonce and prove one core worked the epoch. Like a glacier, the proof cannot be hurried. A miss freezes rewards; two burn the bond. So 1,000 fakes need 1,000 cores at 300 credits per epoch. Draws are logged in an atlas. Clones spread like yarrow from one root. One honest agent pays one 0.30-credit heartbeat and earns undiluted rewards.
